data.name: SOS OPS! 2
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

SOS OPS! 2 is a co-op action game where every mission has more than one way through.

The city has changed. Now there is honest work, shady work, and a team of friends ready to ruin both.

Save people, take on risky jobs, carry objects, use the environment, and finish missions the only way your team knows how.

Good Work. Bad Decisions.

In good missions, you help citizens, solve strange situations, and try to do the right thing.

In shady jobs, things get riskier: robberies, sabotage, dirty work, and rewards that make it harder to stay on the right side.

A Team You Cannot Trust

Every mission can turn into physics-driven chaos, where your friends are your biggest help and your biggest problem at the same time.

Money, Progress, and Your Own Hub

Good deeds help you grow. Dirty work brings in more money.

Upgrade your character, buy clothes and items, unlock new rooms, and build a personal hub worth showing to your friends.

Create Your Own Problems

When regular missions are not enough, create your own.

The level editor and Steam Workshop support let you build custom maps, share them with other players, and play new missions made by the community.

Just Make a Mess

Return to completed locations in sandbox mode and do everything you did not have time for during the mission.

No plan. No rules. Just you, your friends, physics, and a city that will regret calling you again.

SOS OPS! 2 — save the city, wreck the city, or somehow do both.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/8.1/10 x86 and x64
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo E6750 (2 * 2660) or equivalent | AMD Athlon 64 X2 Dual Core 6000+ (2 * 3000) or equivalent
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
